thread:
Lina: starting thread to define SI onboarding "first-deploy" play for hardware partners. goal: SI runs a validated demo in 14 days.
Marco: tight but doable if voucher lead time is managed. propose pre-approved voucher pool for pilots.
Tess: +1. also need a checklist that the SI can self-serve: repo template, quickstart script, sample config.
Lina: draft checklist:
- intake form submitted
- NDA/CLA check
- voucher requested (or pooled)
- repo template cloned
- 30m smoke test scheduled with SE
- evidence uploaded (/evidence/manifest.json)
Marco: evidence triggers CI that validates manifest and posts to LMS webhook for badge. infra-bot, can we add that?
infra-bot: INF-4321 created: repo template + CI + webhook. ETA 4 days. HMAC and rate limit added.
procurement: note: pooled vouchers limited to $2k per pilot; larger requests need PO.
Tess: badge model: one deploy badge (demo run) and capability tags. issuance on webhook success.
Lina: operational KPIs: pilot time-to-demo <=14d, badge issuance <=48h after evidence.
Marco: pilot proposal: 3 SIs, 2-week run, monitor blockers daily. I'll coordinate vendor contacts.
Lina: tasks:
- Marco: vendor coordination + voucher pool request (3d)
- Tess: repo template + quickstart (2d)
- infra-bot: INF-4321 work (4d)
- procurement: confirm voucher pool terms (2d)
Lina: scheduling a 20m standup next Tue to confirm roster. Ping here for any blockers. :white_check_mark:
